newsitem.title: ZAIRE: Zaire says it has recaptured town in east.
newsitem.headline: Zaire says it has recaptured town in east.

text.p: Zaire's government said on Thursday that its army had launched its promised counter-offensive against rebels in the east and recaptured the town of Walikale.
A defence ministry statement said that the town had fallen on Wednesday and that 100 rebels including an unnamed rebel chief had been killed. Zairean casualties were 20 soldiers wounded, it added.
The statement announced "the recapture of the city of Walikale by the Zairean armed forces" and accused the rebels of using drugged youngsters as human shields.
"The Zairean armed forces in effect unleashed their counter-offensive on Monday January 20 to recover (lost) national territory," it said.

"This counter-offensive, which is total and devastating, intensified on January 22 with fierce fighting around Walikale, killing 100 of the enemy including a big leader," it added. It did not name the leader.

The Tutsi-led rebels seized towns and territory in the east after launching an offensive in October, humiliating the Zairean army which retreated in disarray. President Mobutu Sese Seko reshuffled the government and army leadership in December in response to the revolt.
